name: a2cr
description: AI-agent handoff checkpoints and temporary WorkStash notes stored in a local workspace.
long_description: A2CR lets Claude Desktop save and load compact WorkBaton checkpoints and supporting WorkStash notes through a local MCP server. WorkBaton and WorkStash content is validated, encrypted, and stored on the user's machine; this MCPB does not upload saved content.

tools.name: get_account_limits
tools.description: Return current local A2CR workspace limits and storage metadata.

tools.name: list_contexts
tools.description: List WorkBaton Slot metadata without returning stored content.

tools.name: save_context
tools.description: Validate and save compact WorkBaton handoff content in the local A2CR workspace.

tools.name: load_context
tools.description: Load a WorkBaton Slot by name or number and decrypt its content locally.

tools.name: store_work_stash
tools.description: Encrypt and save a temporary supporting note in the local A2CR workspace.

tools.name: get_work_stash
tools.description: Load one referenced WorkStash entry and decrypt its content locally.

tools.name: list_work_stash
tools.description: List local WorkStash metadata without returning stored note values.

tools.name: delete_work_stash
tools.description: Delete one local WorkStash entry that is no longer needed.
